name: Automatic clip and latch machine
summary: Automated equipment for automatic installation of clips or latches, with precision positioning for quick latching assembly.
contentHtml:
The automatic clip and latch machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for clip assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision mechanical structure combined with servo drive to achieve automatic gripping, positioning, and installation of clips or latches. Equipped with a vision inspection system to ensure latching quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic latching assembly with high efficiency
  • Precision positioning with high assembly accuracy
  • Equipped with vision inspection for guaranteed quality
  • Adapts to products of multiple sizes
